detail:
Key (NEW): R1b|fnn-log-discard-spare|fnn-log-spare-close-debt:unlocked-write @ host/native/io.lisp:8374.

Actor A: fnn-log-prepare-spare (io.lisp:8387-8404) runs off O under the spare lock S on whichever thread asks: the maintenance thread (owner.lisp:7439) and the reclaim pass (owner.lisp:7984, from the 'store reclaim --recorded' command thread, admin.lisp:483), which calls it before capturing.
Actor B: fnn-log-rotate (io.lisp:8444-8484) on the publication path, under O only: reads the spare slot, sets it nil (io.lisp:8484) and calls fnn-log-discard-spare, which writes fnn-log-spare-close-debt (io.lisp:8374).
No common lock; the ACL2 in-flight guard (fn-owner-orcp-capture) does not cover the spare preparation.

Hazard: a due publication overlapping an operator reclaim can rotate in a half-prepared spare, or the preparer's discard can act on a custody slot already consumed by rotate.
fix: Take S inside rotate's spare read, clear and discard, or run the reclaim's prepare-spare inside the publication-exclusive section; then declare the slot's protector.
notes: Fixed at 217af5ba7: the spare slot and spare-close-debt are accessed only under the new leaf lock SL (fnn-log-spare-slot-lock, no I/O under it) via fnn-log-spare-peek/-install/-clear/-take; S stays the preparers' I/O lock and is not taken under O. Key R1b|fnn-log-discard-spare|fnn-log-spare-close-debt:unlocked-write gone, none added. natives_owed: tests/test_native_checkpoint_auto.py, tests/test_native_log_compaction.py, tests/test_native_commit_log.py, tests/test_native_host_lifecycle.py.
title: Log spare slot and fnn-log-spare-close-debt are guarded by S in prepare but by O only in rotate and discard (R1b)
